beats.en: Lencho is a farmer whose field of ripe corn needs only a good rain to be ready. His house stands alone on a hill in a valley.

beats.en: The rain came, but it turned into hail. The hailstones destroyed the whole crop, and Lencho's family faced a year of hunger.
